summary: Listed with coordinates on the NC lookout-tower list in Gaston County. No source read describes the lookout; a WBTV transmitter on the same mountain is not tied to it.

evidence.supports: lookout listed as Spencer Mountain in Gaston County with coordinates
first commercial TV signal in the Carolinas from a transmitter on Spencer Mountain, 1949
evidence.quote: broadcast the first commercial television signal in the Carolinas from its transmitter on Spencer Mountain

evidence.supports: date of the first commercial TV broadcast, July 15, 1949
transmitter moved to a new tower in Dallas, NC, in 1984
evidence.quote: WBTV's transmitter remained on Spencer Mountain until 1984, when a new transmitter tower was completed in Dallas, North Carolina

evidence.supports: old transmitter tower truncated and still in use
evidence.quote: The old transmitter tower on Spencer Mountain has since been truncated, but it is still in use by various groups

notes_for_editor: Only one list entry covers a fire lookout here, with no build, design, staffing or fate. The Forest Lookouts page titled Spencer Mountain is for a Maine mountain, not this site, and was not used. Gaston Gazette pages returned HTTP 403 and were not read. The Wikipedia article is about the town and describes the WBTV transmitter, which it does not tie to a fire lookout; the story says so. A Facebook group post mentions a WBTV tower on Spencer Mountain but was not used. Story kept short because nothing else is supported.
